name: 10-days-to-faster-reading
title: 10 Days to Faster Reading
author: Abby Marks Beale and The Princeton Language Institute
description: Abby Marks Beale's "10 Days to Faster Reading" — a self-paced 10-day program to double reading speed while maintaining comprehension. Covers pacing techniques, reducing subvocalization/regression/mind-wandering, widening eye span, previewing, skimming, and flexible reading rates. Trigger when users say: "speed reading" "faster reading" "how to read faster" "improve reading speed" "slow reader."
